name: Slack
description: Connect to Slack to share messages and create canvases directly to simplify collaboration and boost productivity. Search and retrieve messages, channels, threads, files, and users, giving Claude the context to streamline your work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Slack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Slack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.slack.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Slack MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slack provides these MCP tools: slack_send_message, slack_search_public_and_private, slack_search_users, slack_search_channels, slack_search_public, slack_read_channel, slack_read_thread, slack_create_canvas, slack_update_canvas, slack_read_canvas, and slack_read_user_profile.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Slack?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Slack in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Slack requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Slack is developed by Slack. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
